ns2:group.ns2:title: This mistake made a Labubu “lose face”
ns2:group.ns2:description:
A Labubu keychain turned into a “faceless doll” after being wiped with nail polish remover, highlighting potential material risks with collectible toys.
A consumer in Henan told Jiemian News that after noticing stains, they used a remover wipe to clean the figure — only to find its facial features completely erased. The Labubu, purchased earlier this year, was later discarded.
Customer service from Pop Mart said plush keychains should be cleaned gently with an eraser or alcohol-free wipes. Products like nail polish remover, detergents, or alcohol-based cleaners are not recommended, as they may damage the surface.
The main ingredients in nail polish remover — acetone or ethyl acetate — can dissolve or deform materials such as PVC and polyester, commonly used in Labubu products.

ns2:group.ns2:title: Trump pauses Iran strike plan for two weeks
ns2:group.ns2:description:
The U.S. has agreed to pause planned military action against Iran for two weeks, following a request from Pakistan, according to Chinese state media. U.S. President Donald Trump said the pause is conditional on Iran ensuring safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz.
Washington said it had received a 10-point proposal from Iran and viewed it as a basis for negotiations. The White House added that Israel has agreed to a temporary ceasefire, signaling a broader de-escalation effort.
Iran’s Supreme National Security Council later said it accepted Pakistan’s ceasefire proposal, with talks set for April 10 in Islamabad to finalize details. The proposal includes controlled access through the strait, an end to attacks on Iran and its allies, and a withdrawal of U.S. forces from Gulf bases.
Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said the ceasefire took effect at 8 a.m. Beijing time.

基因突變導致癌症的理論已研究很長時間。這模式推動了大量研究，但卻沒看到我們想要的當前癌症治療結果。
雖涉及基因突變，但其他研究顯示突變是在癌症發生後出現的。這項研究還表示，癌不在基因中，而是起源於線粒體。
一個有趣的實驗告訴我們，環境和生活方式最終是癌症的背後原因。 但你可積極主動對抗癌症的激活物。例如，改變飲食、運動、避免電磁場，並更加了解你的環境以及它如何影響健康。 預防癌症、抗癌： 1. 做運動、勞動，來積極降低壓力 2.走進大自然、 3.改變環境、 4.吃維生素B1、 5.吃降壓草本，如南非醉茄(Ashwagandha) 6.參與社交環境、 7.幫助他人、捐贈或有所貢獻。都能減輕壓力。 8.積極主動做些事，來應付生活壓力， 如不看瘋狂新聞，不和負面的人來往 9.吃不發炎飲食、 10.注意環境並檢查電磁場，遠離電磁波

世衛組織表示除草劑會致癌，但美國環保署卻說它安全。真相是什麼？
除草劑 (Roundup) 自1974年開始在農業上被用來除雜草。 1994年出現了基改作物，這些作物可抵抗除草劑毒性。 這使除草劑廣泛使用，也使美國食物的化學物質升高。 此外，除草劑還會在收割前被噴在小麥作物上當乾燥劑。
世衛組織、美國環保署檢視的是同一批除草劑資料，但卻得出了完全不同的結論。 2022年，聯邦法院重審美國環保署對除草劑安全性的判定，認為結論缺乏充分證據。 法院指出，美國環保署沒納入除草劑與癌症相關的動物研究，並忽略腫瘤研究結果。
癌症不是除草劑唯一健康風險。多年來，有人認為除草劑只會透過莽草酸作用 (Shikimate Pathway) 殺死植物，因此對人類很安全，因為人類沒這作用。 然而，腸道菌其實是有這作用的。

ns2:group.ns2:title: The crew on the Artemis II mission have officially completed their lunar flyby on April 6th
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Astronauts on the Artemis II mission have officially completed their lunar flyby on April 6th and are on their way home. For the mission, the crew journeyed to observe the far side of the Moon, and reached the furthest distance humans have travelled from Earth.
Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen took turns taking photos of the Moon’s surface, capturing visual information such as regolith colors, textures, and morphologies. The crew’s distance from the Moon provided more visual surface area and views of craters that have not been previously captured by the Apollo missions. While the livestream was filmed by the cameras inside and outside the Orion spacecraft, the astronauts captured photos using Nikon D5s paired with 80-400mm lenses. NASA also noted that it wanted astronauts to view and describe what the astronauts were seeing using the unaided human eye.
However, the crew still had to shield their eyes using eclipse glasses when they witnessed the first ever solar eclipse from the other side of the Moon, as the spacecraft passed behind the Moon which blocked out the Sun from their viewpoint. This was an extremely unique science opportunity for the teams to gather data about the Sun's outer atmosphere, the corona.
The science conducted during this mission has been historic, but there was also a touching moment when Commander Reid Wiseman named one of the Moon's craters after his late wife, Carroll. The crew returns back to the Earth's surface on Friday, April 10th.

電解質在身體中擔任重要的功能，包括： 1. 神經傳導 2. 肌肉抽筋 3. 液體流動（補水） 4. 酸鹼值 5. 能量
